neighbours.label: data moving across a network: ' data'/' traffic' being sent, routed or passing through a connection
fire: All traffic between the branch offices is routed through an encrypted tunnel.
The firewall inspects every packet of data that passes from the internet to the server.
When you stream a film, the data travels through dozens of routers before it reaches you.
The gateway forwards sensor data to the cloud every few seconds over a cellular link.
Network engineers noticed that most outgoing traffic was being sent to a single address.
A VPN hides the data you send from anyone watching the coffee shop's wireless network.
During the outage, all web traffic was redirected through a backup data centre.
The protocol splits the data into small packets and transmits them over the link.
quiet: All the files from the branch offices are stored on one shared hard drive.
The spreadsheet holds every record that the accountant entered last year.
When you edit a film, the software needs a lot of memory and a fast processor.
The device saves its sensor readings to a memory card every few seconds.
Network engineers noticed that the server room was getting too warm in summer.
A password manager keeps your logins in a file that only you can open.
During the outage, the staff wrote their notes by hand in paper notebooks.
The program sorts the numbers into small groups and prints them in a table.

notes: card: peaks on ' Data' exchanged between server and user, routing calls ' through' a CDN, internet ' traffic' which ' passes' through, forward ' data'; output promotes routing/outgoing/destination/via. Near misses: computing context, data at rest.
